verdict.rationale: Evidence shows guardrail-related primitives — Azure RBAC for fine-grained access control, managed identities, and cost budgets/alerts — but nothing documenting subscription/management-group isolation, landing zones, or dedicated sandbox/org-unit patterns that would let developers experiment without risking production. Missing for 10: documented management groups/subscription isolation patterns, sandbox/dev-test environment guidance, landing zone architecture, and any explicit prod-vs-experiment separation guardrails.
